principle_violations.reason: The current PaymentProcessor class violates the open-closed principle, as the existing source code of the class would have to be modified for each new payment method (such as PayPal, credit card or bank transfer).
principle_violations.suggestion: In order to comply with the open-closed principle, the PaymentProcessor class should be implemented as an abstract base class. A separate class is then created for each specific payment method, which inherits from this abstract class (e.g. CreditCardPaymentProcessor, PayPalPaymentProcessor).
